newsitem.title: BELGIUM: NATO's Solana calls for end to Mostar violence.
newsitem.headline: NATO's Solana calls for end to Mostar violence.

text.p: NATO Secretary General Javier Solana called on Tuesday for an end to violence in the Bosnian town of Mostar, which he said was undermining the region's peace process.
"He calls on all those responsible to work to put an immediate stop to the violent acts, including eviction of people from their homes and other provocations," a statement from his office said.
Solana was visiting Georgia on Tuesday.

Bosnian authorities imposed a curfew in Mostar on Monday after one person was killed and 22 were wounded in ethnic violence in which Bosnian Croats fired shots towards Moslem pilgrims trying to visit a local cemetery.
